text: Hello, has anyone turned in a cell phone? I think I left mine in a taxi this morning.
Well, our taxi drivers find lots of cell phones every day. Can you describe it?
Yes, it's purple. And it's in an orange case
Hmm.... Those are unusual colors. Let's see... no, I'm sorry, we don't have it.
Are you sure? I have to find it...it has all my important information in it. Wait what's that? Oh, it's in my jacket pocket!
